scope: Optional request-bound displayed HUD, presentation protocol /2

runtime.binding: All successful reads within each game retained one producer epoch and used distinct request challenges, including reload.
runtime.TFTD_pointer_exit: Generic observation unavailability; a subsequent pointer-return read remained unavailable, without stale HUD.
runtime.initial_UFO_attempt: An additional initial menu request returned generic unavailability. Its cause was not established. An explicit relaunch preceded the seven successful UFO reads.

separate_screenshot_comparisons.method: Validated presentation responses were retained before HUD-only projection and their cursor RGB crops compared with separately sampled game screenshots. The screenshots were not simultaneous with the acknowledged presentation.
separate_screenshot_comparisons.mismatch_context: These separately sampled crops included animated map content. The differences are retained as non-matches; their precise per-pixel causes were not established.

evidence_boundary: No screenshots, game assets, saves, raw response packets or request identifiers are included in this publication.
Nine separate screenshot/crop comparisons matched exactly; two did not. This is not simultaneous screenshot equivalence or full-frame proof.

Native sources remained unchanged during runtime verification. Documentation, metadata and glyph-source attribution comments were updated afterward without runtime logic changes; no additional game runtime rerun was performed for those edits.
No complete hidden-state timing, platform, transient-event, full perceptual-parity or gameplay-controller acceptance proof is claimed.
No end-to-end token, wall-clock or other resource-saving claim is made.
